Message from ORA

From the ORA eTraining module "Building the Project Team: Contractual Hiring and Compensation" (lesson 15 of 15).
Training Development is on the Rise at MSU!
Thank you so much for reviewing our training module exploring research activities that impact the Contractual Salaries Banner pool! Modules are constantly in development to provide guidance on other grant administration activities at MSU. Visit our webpage here for more training and resource material. If you have questions, or any suggestions for module development, please feel encouraged to contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator, Ryan Mobley. See you next time!
